checks.item: Actual Gaussian width and sharp normalization
checks.detail: The width is the actual Gaussian-law infinity-norm integral, equal to independentAbsGaussianMean for the identity factor. The upper bound optimizes the actual Gaussian exponential moment at sqrt(2log(2p)); Jensen gives E||G||<=sqrt(2log(2p)) with the exact leading constant. The lower bound compares the actual one-sided iid Gaussian maximum integral to the infinity norm and uses the independently checked printed uniform-integrability mean limit. Squeezing proves g_I/sqrt(2logp)->1.

checks.item: Only the printed new vanishing-rate premise
checks.detail: The exact new rate is B*g_I*log(ep)/sqrt n. Its ratio to old B*log(p)^(3/2)/sqrt n tends to sqrt2 for arbitrary varying B_n>=2. The old rate tending to zero is derived by division by this nonzero limiting ratio, and is not an extra premise.

The code uses the checked printed-F1 old strict lower constant sqrt2/(4e), not the looser archived maintext consequence. The new/old rate tends to sqrt2. A real intermediate constant strictly between b*sqrt2 and sqrt2/(4e), followed by the EReal liminf argument, yields exactly1/(4e) without loss. Both rates are proved positive eventually. The argument remains valid when the auxiliary test constant is negative and imposes no upper bound on distance/rate.

The existential witness is lowerRawRows on the explicit product law lowerArrayLaw. LowerConstructionProperties was inspected through LowerConstruction, LowerProductArray and LowerTwoPoint: iid row pushforwards are exactly the product of the displayed two-point law, coordinate independence holds under the actual array law, BoundedIndependentHypotheses supplies actual row independence, centering, integrability and a.e. raw envelope; raw row covariance and normalized-sum covariance are exactly identity.

The positive scalar endpoint B has mass1/(B^2+1)>0. A fixed coordinate equal to B, together with the actual a.e. infinity-norm upper bound, has positive probability and forces norm=B. The transfer to each actual raw row uses its proved pushforward measure. No attainment property is assumed.

The equality between sumVector lowerNormalizedRows and normalizedObservationSum lowerRawRows is proved and rewrites the actual rectangle comparison. Identity Gaussian covariance and the actual raw finite observation properties are outputs, not supplied Gaussian-comparison or construction hypotheses.

checks.item: Quantifier order and finite dimension convention
checks.detail: All statements allow arbitrary varying B_n>=2 and p_n->infinity. theorem_3_intrinsic returns one explicit entire raw-array family. Finite-row properties are asserted for n>=1,p_n>=1; p_n divergence guarantees these eventually. theorem_3_intrinsic_positive_dimensions states the all-positive-sample-size variant under the paper’s positive-coordinate-dimension convention. This avoids a false envelope-attainment assertion in dimension zero and introduces no asymptotic restriction beyond the manuscript’s dimension convention.
